salt-grain.name: klayout-live-verify
salt-grain.title: Live DRC for KLayout (PDK deck on the area you edit)
salt-grain.doc: Tools > Live verify: DRC of the visible area (in-process width/space checks at once, then the PDK's KLayout deck on a clipped copy in a background process), and a live mode that checks the area you just edited. Results in the Marker Browser ("Live DRC") and as markers on the canvas. sky130A first.
